svg.text: A tool call at the gateway: what API Management checks
The same policy runs for the MCP server and for the REST API · Last updated 2026-11-12
Validate token: signature, tenant, audience, scope
Is azp this server's agent? Is the tool allowed for azp?
Rate limit per agent and user; write the audit trace
Any failed check stops here: 401 for the token, 403 for the allow-list, 400 for bad parameters, 429 for the limit. Copilot Studio shows each to the agent as tool text.
